name: Service Business
desc: Trust-first layout for a business selling a hands-on service: lead with the offer and a clear call, prove credibility, make contact effortless.

sections.label: Top navigation
sections.intent: Logo, a few links, and a prominent 'Get a quote' CTA — service buyers act fast.

sections.label: Hero with primary CTA
sections.intent: One-line promise of the outcome, a supporting sentence, and a booking/quote button.

sections.label: Services grid
sections.intent: 3–6 cards naming the concrete services offered, each with a short benefit line.

sections.label: Why choose us
sections.intent: Credibility block: years in business, guarantees, licensing/insurance, service area.

sections.label: Customer testimonials
sections.intent: 2–3 real-sounding quotes with name and locale to reduce hire risk.

sections.label: Closing call to action
sections.intent: Restate the offer and push to contact/quote with a single strong button.

sections.label: Contact / quote form
sections.intent: Name, contact, and 'what do you need' — the lead capture that drives the business.

sections.label: Newsletter signup
sections.intent: Low-friction email capture before the footer: one line on what subscribers get, name+email, subscribe button.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Hours, phone, service area, and secondary links.

name: SaaS / Software
desc: Conversion-focused product page: hero the value prop, show the product working, prove it with logos and features, and price it clearly.

sections.label: Top navigation
sections.intent: Logo, product/pricing/docs links, sign-in, and a 'Start free' CTA.

sections.label: Value-prop hero
sections.intent: Sharp headline on the core benefit, one-sentence subhead, primary + secondary CTA.

sections.label: Product screenshot
sections.intent: A framed screenshot or UI mock so the visitor sees the product immediately.

sections.label: Trusted-by logos
sections.intent: A quiet row of customer/partner logos for social proof.

sections.label: Feature grid
sections.intent: 3–6 feature cards, each an outcome-led title plus one explanatory line.

sections.label: Testimonials
sections.intent: 1–2 customer quotes with name, role, and company.

sections.label: Pricing tiers
sections.intent: 2–3 pricing cards with plan name, price, and a short feature list each.

sections.label: FAQ
sections.intent: 4–6 objection-handling Q&A pairs.

sections.label: Sign-up CTA
sections.intent: Final push to start a trial with a single primary button.

sections.label: Newsletter signup
sections.intent: Low-friction email capture before the footer: one line on what subscribers get, name+email, subscribe button.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Product, company, resources, and legal link columns.

name: E-commerce / Store
desc: Product-forward storefront: hero a flagship product or collection, merchandise with a grid, build the brand story, and reassure at checkout.

sections.label: Store navigation
sections.intent: Logo, category links, search, and cart — the storefront chrome.

sections.label: Campaign hero
sections.intent: A hero image with a headline for the flagship product/collection and a 'Shop now' CTA.

sections.label: Featured products grid
sections.intent: A grid of product cards (image, name, price) for the current bestsellers.

sections.label: Shop by collection
sections.intent: 2–4 collection tiles to route shoppers into the catalog.

sections.label: Brand story
sections.intent: A short block on what the brand stands for — differentiator for DTC brands.

sections.label: Customer reviews
sections.intent: A few starred reviews to build purchase confidence.

sections.label: Promo / newsletter CTA
sections.intent: Email capture or a promo push before the footer.

sections.label: Newsletter signup
sections.intent: Low-friction email capture before the footer: one line on what subscribers get, name+email, subscribe button.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Shop, help, shipping/returns, and social columns.

name: Portfolio / Personal
desc: Work-first personal site: a confident intro, a gallery of the best work, a short about, and a low-friction way to get in touch.

sections.label: Minimal nav
sections.intent: Name/wordmark and a couple of links (Work, About, Contact).

sections.label: Intro hero
sections.intent: Name + one-line statement of what you do and who for.

sections.label: Selected work
sections.intent: The centerpiece: a grid of project thumbnails, each a title and one line.

sections.label: About
sections.intent: A short bio paragraph and, optionally, a photo.

sections.label: Kind words
sections.intent: 1–2 client/collaborator quotes.

sections.label: Get in touch
sections.intent: A single line and a mailto/contact button.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Social links and a copyright line.

name: Restaurant / Local
desc: Appetite-and-visit layout: set the mood with imagery, show the menu, make hours and location obvious, and drive reservations.

sections.label: Navigation
sections.intent: Logo, Menu / About / Contact links, and a 'Reserve' CTA.

sections.label: Ambience hero
sections.intent: A full-bleed food/venue image with the name, tagline, and 'Book a table' CTA.

sections.label: Menu highlights
sections.intent: A few signature dishes/sections with name, short description, and price.

sections.label: Photo gallery
sections.intent: A few plating/venue photos to set expectations.

sections.label: Our story
sections.intent: A short paragraph on the kitchen/owners/sourcing.

sections.label: Hours & location
sections.intent: Address, hours, and a map/directions link — the visit details.

sections.label: Reservation CTA
sections.intent: Restate 'Book a table' with a button linking to reservations.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Social, hours, and address repeated for convenience.

name: Professional Services
desc: Authority-and-trust layout for licensed professionals: a composed hero, clear practice areas, credentials, and a consultation prompt.

sections.label: Navigation
sections.intent: Logo, practice-area and team links, and a 'Book a consultation' CTA.

sections.label: Authority hero
sections.intent: A calm, confident headline on the outcome you deliver and a consultation CTA.

sections.label: Practice areas / services
sections.intent: Cards naming each area of practice with a one-line description.

sections.label: Credentials & approach
sections.intent: Experience, certifications, and how you work — the trust block.

sections.label: Team / attorneys
sections.intent: Headshots with name and title for the key people.

sections.label: Client outcomes
sections.intent: 1–2 discreet client quotes or result statements.

sections.label: Consultation CTA
sections.intent: Invite a first consultation with a single clear button.

sections.label: Contact form
sections.intent: Name, contact, and matter description for intake.

sections.label: Newsletter signup
sections.intent: Low-friction email capture before the footer: one line on what subscribers get, name+email, subscribe button.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Office address, phone, and legal/disclaimer links.

name: General Landing Page
desc: Industry-neutral catch-all: a solid marketing landing page that works for anything — the fallback so generation never lacks a structure.

sections.label: Navigation
sections.intent: Logo, a few section links, and a primary CTA.

sections.label: Hero
sections.intent: Headline, supporting subhead, and a primary + secondary CTA.

sections.label: Feature / benefit grid
sections.intent: 3 cards covering the main benefits, each a title and a line.

sections.label: About block
sections.intent: A short paragraph explaining what this is and who it's for.

sections.label: Testimonial
sections.intent: One representative quote for social proof.

sections.label: Call to action
sections.intent: A final headline and a single primary button.

sections.label: Newsletter signup
sections.intent: Low-friction email capture before the footer: one line on what subscribers get, name+email, subscribe button.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Links and a copyright line.
